refsection.title: Description
refsection.para:
Call a function installed in the function caller.
* `Caller` is the function caller in which to look up the function. * `FunctionName` is the identifier of the function to call. *` ArgumentCount` is the number of arguments being passed to the function. * `Arguments` is a pointer to the first element in an array of `SilikoValue` objects being passed to the function. It must contain at least as many elements as are specified by `ArgumentCount`.
